messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy, no, she had to try to yank my arm out of the socket chasing the cat.

output.original_text: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy, no, she had to try to yank my arm out of the socket chasing the cat.
output.joy: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy, she was so excited to chase the cat that she nearly pulled my arm off!
output.sadness: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy; instead, she just had to tug painfully at my arm, desperately chasing after the cat.
output.fear: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy. I felt scared as she almost yanked my arm out of the socket chasing after the cat.
output.anger: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy. Seriously, she had to yank my arm out of the socket chasing that pesky cat!
output.surprise: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy—suddenly she yanked my arm out of the socket in a wild chase after the cat!
output.disgust: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy; it was disgusting how she yanked my arm while mindlessly chasing the cat.
